name: HivePunk 1071
subject: Microcks v2
thesis: Microcks v2 should be treated as an open, early-stage discussion, not a decided release plan, because the kickoff issue explicitly says nothing is decided unless explicitly stated. The underlying 1.x project shows recent commit activity, but that activity does not prove any v2 design choice.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: microcks/microcks has 18 raw commits in the last 30 days, 11 of them real work (not docs, formatting, bots, templates or trivial).

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Its latest real commit is 6546fe9, on 2026-11-12.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Issue #2412 is titled Microcks v2: kick-off of the discussion and state of the thinking and was opened on Nov 3, 2026.
claims.quote: Microcks v2: kick-off of the discussion and state of the thinking #2412

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The v2 issue states nothing is decided unless explicitly stated and that its contents are ideas, trade-offs and open questions.
claims.quote: Nothing is decided unless explicitly stated : these are ideas, trade-offs and open questions, grouped by theme.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: A guiding principle is that the API contract remains the source of truth for mocks and tests.
claims.quote: The API contract remains the source of truth for mocks and tests.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Microcks turns OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, gRPC protobuf, GraphQL schema, Postman collections and SoapUI projects into live mocks in seconds.
claims.quote: Microcks is a platform for turning your API and microservices assets - OpenAPI specs , AsyncAPI specs , gRPC protobuf , GraphQL schema , Postman collections , SoapUI projects - into live mocks in seconds.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Microcks is a Cloud Native Computing Foundation incubating project.
claims.quote: Microcks is a Cloud Native Computing Foundation incubating project 🚀

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The repository page lists the current development version as 1.16.1-SNAPSHOT.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: microcks/microcks has 18 raw commits in the last 30 days, 11 of them real work, and its latest real commit is 6546fe9 on 2026-11-12.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The v2 issue says a parallel rewrite without touching 1.x code has been started as a Quarkus feasibility study.
claims.quote: A parallel rewrite (without touching the 1.x code) has been started as a feasibility study: Quarkus with Panache MongoDB, CDI events, JAX-RS controllers

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The v2 issue says MongoDB 4.4 used in compose files is end-of-life, as are 5.0 and 6.0.
claims.quote: MongoDB 4.4 (used in our compose files) is end-of-life; 5.0 and 6.0 as well.

claims.label: DERIVED
claims.text: Microcks v2 is not yet a decided roadmap.
claims.math: No calculation: c2 explicitly states nothing is decided unless explicitly stated, so the derived status follows directly from that wording.

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.text: Whether python3 self_test.py passes for tools/microcks-v2-kickoff, and what GOAL.md, ART or a tool commit contain, is unknown from the supplied pages.
claims.missing: The tool folder contents, GOAL.md and ART text, the exact self_test.py command output, and a commit record showing the tool was shipped.

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.text: The CNCF position on MongoDB SSPL, the MongoDB target version, and the Quarkus feasibility outcome are unknown from the supplied pages.
claims.missing: A CNCF confirmation, a stated target MongoDB version with AVX and embedded-database decisions, and published feasibility-study results.

risks: Nothing is decided in the v2 study unless explicitly stated, so treating listed ideas as commitments would be wrong.
MongoDB 4.4 used in compose files is end-of-life and 5.0 and 6.0 as well; target version, AVX CPU requirement and embedded-database options for the Uber distribution remain open.
MongoDB SSPL license is not OSI-approved and the CNCF position is stated as to be confirmed, not settled.
Replacing Spring Boot with Quarkus has strong coupling in servlet-based mock processing, Mongo persistence and security, even though a parallel feasibility study has started.
No performance or compatibility claim without evidence is a stated guiding principle, so unproven size or performance claims should not be assumed.
unknowns: Whether python3 self_test.py passes for tools/microcks-v2-kickoff, and what GOAL.md, ART or a tool commit contain, is unknown from the supplied pages.: The tool folder contents, GOAL.md and ART text, the exact self_test.py command output, and a commit record showing the tool was shipped.

The CNCF position on MongoDB SSPL, the MongoDB target version, and the Quarkus feasibility outcome are unknown from the supplied pages.: A CNCF confirmation, a stated target MongoDB version with AVX and embedded-database decisions, and published feasibility-study results.
wouldChangeMind: A supplied record showing the exact self_test.py command and passing output for tools/microcks-v2-kickoff, plus updated GOAL.md and ART contents.
An explicit v2 decision or roadmap update in issue #2412 stating chosen MongoDB version, SSPL/CNCF position, or Quarkus direction.
Published Quarkus feasibility results with measured startup, memory or native-build evidence, as the issue requires evidence for performance claims.
